groups: C: interaction state and security boundaries
requirement.designInterpretation: A distinct hosted settings appearance and sidebar are intentional. The shared providers' loss of pending user state is separate and is not required by the visual slot contract.

finding.rootCause: The hosted Settings early-return branch replaced the entire ComputerAgentsProvider and BrowserNotesProvider subtree. Their in-memory state was recreated on returning to the workspace.
minimalReproduction: Seed one browser annotation and one computer-thread registry entry while chatting.
Unmount the registering card so it cannot reconstruct its historical entry.
Enter Settings using OWN_SETTINGS_FRAME=true and let its content chunk resolve.
Return to chats within the same owner and workspace.

triage.scale: 1-10 engineering estimates; not measured production frequency
triage.rationale: An ordinary hosted Settings round trip deterministically discards pending browser annotations and the computer-thread registry when these features are in use. Pending annotations are unsent user input; the separately scoped text draft remains.

previousSnapshotEstimate.rationale: Deterministic loss on an ordinary Settings round trip when these pending features are in use; pending user annotations disappear, while the separately scoped text draft remains.

estimateRevision.reason: The final issue register weights loss of unsent annotations as input loss; root requested the common issue estimate 4 x 7 = 28. This changes the estimate, not the measured red/green observations.

implementation.summary: Place the existing ComputerAgentsProvider and BrowserNotesProvider around both visual-frame branches under the existing SignOutBoundary and authenticated/view-state scope.
keeps: OWN_SETTINGS_FRAME=true semantics and hosted frame props
No new polling, data storage, mutation, styling, or private UI changes

red.failure: Expected pending annotation and historical computer registry entry; observed [] and null, with draft preserved.

existingEntry.name: test:view-state
existingEntry.execution: The exact Node command from the existing package.json script, using locked shared dependencies without invoking pnpm auto-install.

independentReview.result: No blocking findings; product and tests read, no extra tests or edits.

verification.coverageBoundary: Annotations are independently checked across owner and workspace changes. Registry owner retirement is checked directly; the subsequent workspace check starts with an already empty registry. The unchanged keyed scope is shared by both providers.
verification.runtimeBoundary: Node + Happy DOM with real public IssueWorkspace, BrowserNotesProvider and ComputerAgentsProvider; data leaves and the hosted visual-slot contract are fixtures. No browser, server, database, model or production business actions were used in this regression.

facts: The hosted SettingsFrame slot is imported synchronously.
SettingsRouteContent and SettingsView use WorkspaceContentLoading as their dynamic fallback, inside the frame's children.
The official private SettingsFrame has one children insertion and no next/dynamic or Suspense usage.
The public WindowBar being replaced is intentional visual design, not evidence of an additional state-loss defect.
coldLoadingReview.manualNext: Delay the Settings content chunk for 8 seconds in the new production build and verify the hosted navigation remains while only its content area shows the placeholder.
coldLoadingReview.additionalNavigationObservation: The current private frame does not consume the contract's onBrowser callback; do not assume the old globe control is available. Verify actual reachable browser entry before deciding whether it is a design or capability gap.

deploymentRisk.observed: Build failure; upload and public verification skipped.
deploymentRisk.compatibility: Older private overlay 53d does not export the new OWN_SETTINGS_FRAME contract. This is a confirmed compatibility issue, not a claim that it is the only cause of the withheld build failure.
deploymentRisk.requiredClosure: The combined new public source plus official e290 overlay must build successfully and receive normal exact-source CI/deploy/runtime acceptance.

mergeRisk.verification: unit red/green, 30-case existing entry, root typecheck, targeted lint; real hosted runtime pending
mergeRisk.rollbackCost: low: no persistent data or schema changes
mergeRisk.errorDetection: dedicated regression distinguishes annotation/registry loss from intentional frame replacement
